paragraphs: FPSI describes itself as an expert in public safety testing. For fire departments and the HR staff who support them, it supplies what a firefighter recruitment or promotional testing process requires. It offers the equivalent for police or deputy sheriff recruitment and promotion.

The assessment suite spans written exams, physical ability tests, structured interviews, and personality measures. FPSI also supports agencies on job analysis, test validation, and compliance. Custom item writing is available for promotional testing needs. For promotion, the company says it provides tools to identify and promote capable leaders within a department. The site also publishes a proctored online test guide for candidates.

The company says that since 1996 it has been dedicated to one mission around public safety hiring and promotion. Its assessments are used by agencies across the U.S. and Canada, according to the site. It reports over 500,000 candidates tested and a 99% customer satisfaction rate. The site is published by Fire & Police Selection, Inc.
